title: Beti
desc: Sudha assumes a recent acquaintance is the man she's being asked to marry and agrees to the match. When she realises her mistake it's too late, and she has to choose between love and family honour.

title: Jurmana
desc: Inder, a contractor who believes in the power of money, places a bet with his friend Prakash to woo Rama, a simple girl. Rama gets charmed by Inder, but an event forces her to leave the city.

title: Waqt Ki Deewar
desc: A cruel and lustful man brutally rapes a woman, forcing her to commit suicide, leaving her young children homeless. The children try to stay together but are separated. Years later, one of them has taken to a life of crime with a friend, who, unbeknownst to him, is none other than his mother's rapist.

title: Teri Payal Mere Geet
desc: Premi makes a living by selling poems to Benni and falls in love with a courtesan, Laila Jaan. However, he leaves her after finding the truth about her but tries to get back with her.
